A true staple of the modern wardrobe, the single-breasted jacket forms the foundation of a considered collection. Our house cut, with clean lines and a 3-roll-2 button stance, creates a sharp, versatile silhouette, featuring a natural shoulder and subtle waist shaping for effortless, everyday ease.
Fully canvassed with a hand-shaped chest, the jacket drapes naturally over the body, while the hand-attached collar and sleeves offer flexibility unmatched by machine construction, allowing it to move seamlessly with the wearer. Inspired by the heritage provisions of the past, and the Kavalan Jacket is exactly that. Featuring 100% shearling and lambskin materials, oversized Talon® zippers, and antiqued brass buckles, this limited production run jacket is an online exclusive for our Winter '22 collection.
The Kavalan Jacket is is a limited production run piece and is of the highest quality craftsmanship. each one cut and put together by hand, these heritage pieces are meant for a lifetime of wear.
SPECS + DETAILS
• Exterior: 7mm lambskin leather
• Interior: 100% shearling interior + collar
• Talon® heavy front zipper closure
• Double-needle felled seams on all critical points: arms, shoulders, etc.
• Contrast lambskin leather accents at the arms, waist pockets, and rear piping on the back
• Antique buckle cinch closure at the collar for added warmth
• Waist buckle cinch adjustment with antique brass buckles
• Top entry angled front hand pockets lined with brushed cotton interior
• Bartack + zig-zag stitch styling on front hem, collar, inside placket + more
• Locker loop draw cord on inside collar
• Imported
